name: Ukikura
displayVersion: 1.0.6 (Patch 54 - Native C++ Hardware Bridge & Restoration of Patch 44 Desktop Architecture)
author: Nauflix
changelog: Ukikura v1.0.6 (Patch 54 - Pemulihan Penuh Arsitektur Desktop Patch 44 & Implementasi Hardware Bridge Native C++ ukikura-bridge.exe): 1) Mengembalikan host desktop utama ke arsitektur Patch 44 yang stabil dan kaya fitur (transparansi tanpa clipping, fisika maskot 11 emosi, lirik sinkron 3 bahasa Romaji/Kanji/Sub-Indo, dan WhatsApp Web background). 2) Menggantikan bridge PowerShell dengan biner native C++ murni (ukikura-bridge.exe) berkinerja tinggi, RAM ~2 MB, 0% CPU idle, untuk kontrol WASAPI master volume, WinRT SMTC media metadata/timeline/thumbnail, baterai laptop/Bluetooth (CfgMgr32), dan Toast notifications. 3) Mengemas installer mandiri offline 100% tanpa perlu unduhan internet.
